name: Appointment Booking Follow-up System — Booking Intake

parameters.jsCode:
const booking = $('Evaluate Slot & Conflict').first().json;
const cal = $input.first() ? $input.first().json : {};
const calEventId = cal.id ? String(cal.id) : ('EVT-' + booking.booking_id);
const now = new Date().toISOString();

return [{
  json: {
    booking_id: booking.booking_id,
    customer_name: booking.customer_name,
    phone_e164: booking.phone_e164,
    email: booking.email,
    service: booking.service,
    source: booking.source || 'website',
    timezone: booking.timezone || 'Asia/Karachi',
    requested_start: booking.requested_start,
    requested_end: booking.requested_end,
    calendar_event_id: calEventId,
    calendar_id: 'primary',
    status: 'confirmed',
    confirmation_sent: true,
    whatsapp_confirmation_sent: true,
    email_confirmation_sent: true,
    reminder_24h_sent: false,
    reminder_1h_sent: false,
    appointment_completed: false,
    no_show: false,
    follow_up_sent: false,
    reschedule_url: booking.reschedule_url,
    created_at: now,
    updated_at: now
  }
}];

parameters.subject: ={{ "Appointment Confirmed: " + $('Format Booking Record').first().json.service + " on " + $('Format Booking Record').first().json.requested_start.split("T")[0] }}
